Gameplay is the most frequently discussed aspect in the sampled reviews, with 12% of all reviews mentioning it. Within those, sentiment is strongly positive: 90 reviews praise the gameplay, while only 20 are negative, with 6 mixed and 4 neutral. Players consistently describe the core experience in favorable terms, calling it "one of the better roguelikes this year" and noting that "the run variety keeps it fresh." Others highlight specific strengths such as "solid deckbuilder" mechanics, "excellent" boss design, and "decent physics puzzles," with one reviewer noting the game "runs great on the Deck."

Criticism is more scattered but recurring around presentation and usability. One player says "the soundtrack carries this whole game, but the inventory UI fights me constantly," while another complains about the "tiny subtitle font." A separate reviewer finds the game "a bit short for the price," and one notes the pacing "drags in act two." Opinion splits on difficulty, with one player calling the curve "brutal but fair" while another simply finds the game "fun while it lasted." A few reviews mention co-op and matchmaking, with one player reporting "good co-op, bad matchmaking" but still recommending the game to friends.
